text:
Aisha: Heads-up — PR #22111 (db-shard-rebalance) is queued and hitting mac-e2e flakes. We need to land before tonight's deploy-blackout at 23:00 PT. Can someone re-run mac matrix or approve a manual canary?

Devon: I can re-run the mac job now. CI queue ETA ~12m. Which tests are flaky?

Aisha: Flake appears in `tests/ui/test-connection-timeout`, intermittent. Failing on 1/3 runs. ci-bot log snippet: ```mac-e2e-42 failed: timeout in test_connection_timeout (signal 137)``` Thought it might be unrelated to my change.

Chris: If it's flaky, we can try a matryoshka rerun pattern: `rerun --matrix mac-e2e --count 3`. I'll kick that if Devon can't.

Devon: kicked rerun. :rocket:

ci-bot: mac-e2e-42 rerun started by Devon.

Jen: Also FYI, rebase window opens at 21:30 PT — if the reruns fail, we can rebase to pick up infra fix in main. Otherwise we need canary approval to ship during blackout window. @Aisha want me to hold canary?

Aisha: Yes please hold canary unless reruns pass. If reruns all pass, tag me and I'll merge. Thanks.

Chris: Rerun 1/3 passed, 2/3 passed, 3/3 failed (same timeout). Looks like a flaky infra issue.

Devon: Given 2/3, I think we should rebase to main and pick latest infra bump. @Aisha can you rebase and push?

Aisha: Rebased and pushed `pr/22111+rebase-2026-03-18`. Triggered new CI.

ci-bot: New pipeline started: mac-e2e-47.

Chris: If this fails, we should plan to wait out blackout. I can monitor and escalate.

Devon: Mac run passed ✅

Aisha: Great — merging now. Thanks all :heart:
